verses.text: Tato ay heb' niwak winak tzex awtan wa'el, scham wal he na'ani mach winh b'aj ayex ek' t'a yichanh.
Wach'chom te ayoch he wejel, wach' tato jab'nhej tze wa''a.
Manh yelk'olalok tze wa jun wa'el manhxo jantakok swach'il chi', talaj ay tas sna winh t'a he patik.
Manh eyak' eyip eyoch b'eyumal, manh ex och ilk'olal yuj juntzanh chi'.
Ha k'e'en tumin junnhej rato slajwiel k'e'en, icha sb'at jenhenhok nok' ch'akb'a, icha chi' tz'aj satxiel k'e'en tumin chi'.
Manh ex em k'ojan t'a smexa heb' ya yel yuj, manh he nib'ejoch swa'el heb' te wach'.
Ha heb' aj wa'el chi', te niwan sna sb'a heb' yuj stojol jun wa'el chi', wach'chom syal heb', wa'anhek xchi heb', palta manh smasanilok sk'o'ol heb' syala'.
Ol he na he b'a yuj tas ix laj he waem chi', malaj yopisio juntzanh he lolonel wach' ix eyutej eyalan t'a heb'.
Manh eyal wach' pensaril t'a junok chuk spensar, yujto tonhej ol b'uchwaj t'a he lolonel wach' chi'.
Manh he k'ex stz'akanhil lum lum aytaxkanem t'a pekataxo, manh he tok'paxek' slu'um heb' chamnak smam snun,
yujto ha Dios Smam heb', a ol kolanel heb', a ol ak'an owal heyet'ok.
Hak'ekoch he chikin t'a he k'ayb'ub'al, ak'ekoch he pensar yik ol eyojtakejeli.
Manh eyaktej eyak'an tzalaj heb' eyuninal, ¿tom wal scham heb' yuj jay pajok tzeyak' t'ay?
Tato tzeyak' tzalaj heb', wan ton he kolankanelta heb' t'a chamel.
Ex wuninal, ayik ol eyik'an jelanil, ayik ol wab'an he lolon icha t'a smojal, ol in te tzalaj eyu'uj.
Manh he nib'ejoch tastak ay t'a heb' tz'och b'eyumal yuj chukal, anhejokab' Jehová niwan yelk'och t'a he sat.
Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, wach'nhej ol ex elk'ochok, haxo tas ayoch yipok he k'o'ol, malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwokelok.
Ex wuninal, tanhwejek eyab'i, tze k'ayb'an wach'ilal, tzeyak'an eyip he b'eyb'alani.
Manh junok tzex ek' yet' heb' uk'um anh yet' heb' tzek' yib'anh swa'i.
Yujto a heb' uk'um anh yet' heb' jelan swa chi', ol te kot mheb'ail t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo pax heb' jaragana toxonhej olchimtak spichul heb' ayoch yuj.
Cham eyab'an tas syal heb' winh he mam, haton heb' winh ix ex ilan pitzwok. Manh he patikejel heb' ix he nun ayik schichimax heb' ix.
Hak'ek eyip he sayan tastak yel, jelanil, k'ayb'ub'al yet' aj pensaril, a juntzanh chi' manh he patikejkaneli.
Ha heb' uninab'il te wach', heb' te ay spensar, ste tzalaj smam heb' yet'ok.
Yuj chi', ak'ek tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol heb' he mam he nun, yik wach' niwan ol aj yelk'och heb' eyu'uj.
Ex wuninal, tanhwejek eyab' tas ol wala', scham wal eyilan in b'eyb'al,
yujto a heb' ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yetb'eyum, lajan heb' ix icha junok olan te jul yich, palta lot'an yo'ol.
Smaklan heb' winh winak heb' ix t'a yol b'e, icha syutej sb'a heb' elk'um, te tzijtum heb' winh winak chi' tz'och smul yuj heb' ix.

Ha heb' max aktankan yuk'an anh anh, heb' hanheja' yab'an swach'il yuk'ji anh anh chi', haton heb' tz'ab'an sya'il, heb' tz'el yaw, heb' te ayoch owal t'a skal, heb' slajwi wach'chom malaj junok tas yuj, heb' chak jochinak yol sat.
Manh eyiloch he k'o'ol t'a anh anh yax t'urinak yilji t'a yol skopail, sekojtak tz'aj yuk'chajemi,
palta haxo t'a slajwub'al jun, lajan icha junok nok' chan manh jantakok sya'il b'aj tzonh schi'a.
Manh jantakok tas ol ak'jok eyil yuj, tzijtum tastak manh wach'ok ol eyal yuj anh, ay pax juntzanh tas manh wach'ok ol he nak'e yuj anh anh chi'.
Icha wal to ha t'a yib'anh ha' mar ayex ek' ol eyutej heyilani, oyb'inakxo he sat, icha wal to t'a schon ste'al junok niwan barco ayex k'e tzeyab'i.
Haxo ol eyalan icha tik: Ix onh smak' heb', palta maj kab'laj sya'il, ix onh mak'ji yet' nok' tz'u'um, palta maj kab'laj, haxo ol el lenaj anh t'a ko sat, ol onh b'atxok ko say anh, xe chama.
